title: Transferability Notes (mixin)
description:
Reusable mixin adding a free-text escape hatch for transferability facts that don't reduce cleanly to the controlled vocabularies — e.g. UP-WF2's "the classification algorithm is more portable than its current input dataset."
**Uplifts to `rdfs:comment`**, not to a FOCAL-specific property: a human-readable note about a resource is exactly what `rdfs:comment` is for, every RDF consumer already renders it, and minting a FOCAL term for it would have bought nothing. This is the general rule across the model — a FOCAL term only where nothing published says the same thing.
Mixed in wherever such a note may apply: on bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.envelopeConstraint (why a value is approximate or inferred) and on bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.rule (what degrades when an optional action is skipped).

transferabilityNotes.description: Free-text elaboration of a transferability fact the controlled vocabularies can't capture. Uplifts to `rdfs:comment` on whatever it is attached to.
